hello.body: Hi! Want to know how to sneaking?
hello.speaker: Assistant Pie

briefing1.body: The point of any stealth is to read posts with patrol routes and to be able to get into timings when the post looks the other way and the patrolpony goes on.
briefing1.speaker: Assistant Pie

briefing2.body: Stand in a hiding place. Listen. Watch through the door slits. When the patrolpony passes, move on. You can walk right behind the patrolpony, just keep distance.
briefing2.speaker: Assistant Pie

hidingPlace_answer.body: What are some examples of hiding places?
hidingPlace_answer.speaker: Strikely

hidingPlace1.body: All along the stealth room furniture is set up as a hiding place. Well, almost a hiding place. Robo-eyes bypass points from which they can see what's behind the furniture.
hidingPlace1.speaker: Assistant Pie

hidingPlace2.body: On a mission, office rooms and ventilation shafts serve as hiding places.
hidingPlace2.speaker: Assistant Pie

door_answer.body: What if the doors can't be unlocked with a key or there is no key?
door_answer.speaker: Strikely

door1.body: Well, on the second floor, the locks are stronger than an office door. So you could just kick down it in with one solid punch.
door1.speaker: Assistant Pie

door2.body: But if there's no key to the vault door...  No clone has ever managed to kick it down or burn it out. At least not before the scientists got bored with it.
door2.speaker: Assistant Pie

door3.body: You can't kick down that gray door either.
door3.speaker: Assistant Pie

door4.body: But you can kick down the door at the end of the stealth room. Practice on it.
door4.speaker: Assistant Pie

moreBriefing1.body: You are lucky that terrorists wear a closed uniform with a mask. By wearing this uniform, you can pretend to be a terrorist. However, this disguise will only work on the second floor. On the first floor and on the street there is a strictly fixed number of guard, and if they see a terrorist walking freely, they will immediately suspect something wrong.
moreBriefing1.speaker: Assistant Pie

moreBriefing2.body: And in the beginning, you'll have an optional one-minute head start in the form of a StealthBuck.
moreBriefing2.speaker: Assistant Pie

moreBriefing_answer_stealthbuck.body: Remind me again what a StealthBuck is?
moreBriefing_answer_stealthbuck.speaker: Strikely

moreBriefing3.body: The thingy-doody that makes you invisible. It is fragile and breaks when you are shot and change clothes.
moreBriefing3.speaker: Assistant Pie

practice1.body: The goal of the challenge is to sneak past the robo-eyes to the farthest room and score a reward from the bag.
practice1.speaker: Assistant Pie

practice2.body: Along the way, you can shoot off the robo-eyes with tranquilizer from Assistant Shy. Don't worry, they won't get hurt. When you restart the challenge, they are restored.
practice2.speaker: Assistant Pie

practice3.body: The entrance to the far room closes when robo-eyes detect you. Formally, the challenge will be successfully failure.
practice3.speaker: Assistant Pie

practice4.body: Informally, you can kick down a locked door. The ability to get around doors is just as useful as the ability to sneak.
practice4.speaker: Assistant Pie

stealthbuck_answer.body: I was told that I could get a StealthBuck from you.
stealthbuck_answer.speaker: Strikely

stealthbuck1.body: Yes. It's lying behind that door, but it's being guarded by robo-eyes.
stealthbuck1.speaker: Assistant Pie

stealthbuck2.body: Don't get caught by their robo-eyes, and this StealthBuck will be yours!
stealthbuck2.speaker: Assistant Pie

button.body: Click on the red button next to the door to start the test!
button.speaker: Assistant Pie
